facts.en: GPS needs at least four satellites to pin down your location.

facts.en: The first emoji set was created in Japan in 1999.

facts.en: 'password' is still among the most commonly used—and worst—passwords.

facts.en: By the mid-2020s, more than half of humanity was online.

facts.en: In Morse code, SOS is three short, three long, three short signals.

facts.en: Nepal covers 147,516 square kilometres.

facts.ne: नेपालको राजधानी काठमाडौं हो, समुद्र सतहबाट करिब १,४०० मिटर उचाइमा।
facts.en: Nepal's capital Kathmandu sits at about 1,400 m above sea level.

facts.en: Eight of the world's 14 peaks above 8,000 m are in Nepal.

facts.ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय फूल लालीगुराँस हो।
facts.en: Nepal's national flower is the rhododendron (laligurans).

facts.ne: नेपालको झन्डा विश्वको एक मात्र गैर-आयताकार राष्ट्रिय झन्डा हो।
facts.en: Nepal's flag is the world's only non-rectangular national flag.

facts.ne: गाई नेपालको राष्ट्रिय जनावर र डाँफे राष्ट्रिय चरा हो।
facts.en: The cow is Nepal's national animal and the danphe its national bird.

facts.en: Nepal has more than 125 ethnic groups and 123 languages.

facts.ne: चितवन राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज नेपालको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय निकुञ्ज हो।

facts.en: Nepal's flag bears symbols of the moon and the sun.

facts.ne: नेपालको राष्ट्रिय गान 'सयौं थुँगा फूलका' हो।

facts.en: Janakpur is regarded as the heart of ancient Mithila.

facts.en: Remittances are a major part of Nepal's economy.

facts.en: The FIFA World Cup began in 1930.

facts.ne: नेपालले सन् २००२ मा पहिलो पटक एसिया कप क्रिकेट खेल्यो।
facts.en: Nepal played its first Asia Cup cricket in 2002.

facts.ne: म्याराथन दौड ४२.१९५ किलोमिटर लामो हुन्छ।
facts.en: A marathon is 42.195 km long.

facts.en: The five Olympic rings represent five continents.

facts.en: Only the goalkeeper may use their hands in football.

facts.en: A cricket Test match can last five days.

facts.en: The fastest badminton smash has been measured above 500 km/h.

facts.en: The Tour de France is cycling's most famous race.
